fusions.name: Matted Snare
fusions.desc: Tangles the target in strands and butts it for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a braided length of strands at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Woven Coat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 22 damage for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land weaves a strand into your coat, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per strand (32% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 10 seconds.
